dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: Do... Need... Something? ...Tell.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh... Hello?

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: Ah, sorry... Was my voice too soft for you to hear clearly?

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: I said, do you need something? Please, do tell.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good... bye?

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: ...Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did I disturb you?

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: It's not your fault. It's just an old habit of mine that's acting up.

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: I'm used to speaking softly because I hunt frequently and sometimes meet researchers training in the forest. It's taking me some time to speak normally again.

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: Many mistake me for an introvert because of that, and they are really careful when they talk to me.

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: It isn't necessary at all. Please talk to me normally.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the researchers...

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: Oh, while there aren't many of them, and they are usually in hidden spots, you'll still meet them if you stay in Avidya Forest all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: Honestly, I'm not really sure of the specifics of the principle.

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: I only know that this situation is called something like... Savada Life? It's a special stage in the training of researchers, during which they can't be disturbed.

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: So, I sometimes worry that that inexperienced Trainee Forest Ranger will disturb those Akademiya researchers.

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: Hmm... Still, since she's with the Forest Watchers, I doubt she'll be as reckless as someone who's never read the Rainforest Survival Guide in their lives.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: Wasn't that complicated enough...

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: Feels like you need to read the Genius Invokation TCG rulebook again...
